title: Salem Advocate Bar Association v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Salem Advocate Bar Association v. Union of India, (2005) 6 SCC 344
content.holding: The 90-day outer limit for filing a written statement in ordinary civil suits under Order VIII Rule 1 is directory, not mandatory, but extension must be for recorded exceptional circumstances.
content.relevance: Judicial discretion and timeline flexibility in general CPC civil procedure.
